description: Read your durable crosslisting tasks and available eBay accounts. Only verified items are confirmed live; pending or verifying is not failure and must not be republished. Read one task to paginate its items. This does not make a fresh marketplace request.

limit.description: Items for a single task. Default 10, maximum 30. Task lists show three items each.

offset.description: Item offset for a single task. Default 0.

task_id.description: Read one task; omit for the latest ten tasks and available eBay accounts.

name: get_crosslisting_tasks
